title: Checkpoints & Full Model Saving 📦
description: Save entire models, optimizers, and full training checkpoints.

slides.title: Saving More Than Weights 📋
slides.content:
# Training Checkpoints

To resume training exactly where you stopped, save not only `model.state_dict()` but also:
* `optimizer.state_dict()` (momentum, etc.)
* Current epoch number
* Loss value
* Random number generator states

Wrap them in a dictionary and save.

slides.title: Saving a Full Checkpoint
slides.content: Save model, optimizer, and epoch info.
slides.codeSnippet:
model = nn.Linear(10, 2)
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters())
epoch = 5
loss = 0.023

checkpoint = {
    'epoch': epoch,
    'model_state_dict': model.state_dict(),
    'optimizer_state_dict': optimizer.state_dict(),
    'loss': loss
}
torch.save(checkpoint, 'checkpoint.pth')
print('Checkpoint saved')

quizData.question: Why include the optimizer state when saving a checkpoint?

options.text: To resume training with the same momentum and learning rate schedule

quizData.explanation: Optimizer state contains per‑parameter buffers like momentum; restoring it continues training seamlessly.

slides.title: Loading a Checkpoint
slides.codeSnippet:
model = nn.Linear(10, 2)
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters())

checkpoint = torch.load('checkpoint.pth')
model.load_state_dict(checkpoint['model_state_dict'])
optimizer.load_state_dict(checkpoint['optimizer_state_dict'])
start_epoch = checkpoint['epoch']
print(f'Resuming from epoch {start_epoch}')

slides.title: Saving Entire Model (Not Recommended) 🧐
slides.content:
## `torch.save(model, 'model.pth')`

This saves the whole class using `pickle`. It's fragile: class definitions and imports must match exactly when loading. Prefer `state_dict` for models.

```python
model = ...
torch.save(model, 'entire_model.pth')
loaded_model = torch.load('entire_model.pth')
```

quizData.question: Why is saving the entire model with `torch.save(model, ...)` less portable?

options.text: It requires the exact same class definition and imports at load time

quizData.explanation: Pickling the model stores the class path; loading needs the same environment.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Save Multiple Checkpoints

Keep several checkpoint files (e.g., 'checkpoint_epoch_10.pth') to roll back to different stages or track experiment history.
